verdict.rationale: SES's Virtual Deliverability Manager explicitly offers 'deliverability insights' and 'recommendations to improve inbox placement' beyond raw bounce/complaint counts, and core monitoring tracks bounce/complaint/reject rates. However, community accounts describe SES's out-of-box reporting as thin ('you need to code a lot of the stuff... like delivery reports yourself') and VDM is a separate paid add-on rather than a built-in analytics dashboard, and some users report ongoing deliverability/reputation problems that suggest guidance isn't always actionable or trusted. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of VDM's actual guidance quality, engagement analytics (opens/clicks) details, and confirmation this is bundled by default rather than an extra-cost/opt-in tool.
